events.title: Deck the Hall | Christmas Tree Competition
events.description:
Get ready to deck the halls and show off your holiday creativity!

Deck the Halls is a festive Christmas tree decorating competition where teams, businesses, organizations, and community members can transform a Christmas tree into their own unique holiday masterpiece.

Decorate during the week of thanksgiving and take down is the first week of January. Choose a theme, gather your team, and let your imagination run wild! Whether your tree is traditional and elegant, hilariously over-the-top, or completely unexpected, we want to see what you can create. Then the community gets to vote! Every penny counts as a vote, and the tree with the most votes wins! The winning group get to choose a local nonprofit to receive ALL of the proceeds! Trees will be on display for the community to enjoy.

It’s a fun way to celebrate the holiday season, showcase local creativity, and bring a little extra Christmas magic to the community.

Think you have what it takes to take home the title?

Grab your ornaments, lights, garland, and your best decorating crew—and get ready to Deck the Halls!

Contact Sami at spettey@co.mckenzie.nd.us to enter, and the entry fee is $20.

Perhaps the perfect movie to represent the very American holiday Thanksgiving, Planes, Trains and Automobiles \(1987, R\) captures e verything about the holiday. The weary traveling to get home. Being grateful for what you have in life. And being kind to those around you. Director John Hughes made a career on bringing Chicago to life, and in this story it's the struggle to get to the Windy City that takes center stage. Join comedians Steve Martin and John Candy as they are thrown together and trying to survive the journey and each other. Part of the Badlands Film Appreciation Society's Everlasting Eighties series \(bfas .art\).

events.title: Babette's Feast
events.description:
Building: Student Center Room: Movie Theater Organizer: Badlands Film Appreciation Society Category: Clubs and Orgs,Community Events,Fine and Performing Arts,Student Activities Audience: Pu blic Cost to attend: Free Link: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0093748/?ref\_=nv\_sr\_srsg\_0\_tt\_8\_nm\_0\_in\_0\_q\_planes%20trains

Of course, another key aspect of Thanksgiving is the feast, shared by loved ones as a sign of gratitude for surviving another year and being loved by others. While set in Denmark in the late 19th century, Babette's Feast \(1987, G\) fully captures that Thanksgiving spirit. The film presents the story of two elderly sisters who have tried to keep alive their father's ministry to a remote village in Denmark. Th ey help a French refugee who repays their years of kindness with a sumptuous feast fit for a king. Love is in full force as this small group of believers huddle together against the cold dark and learn that good food truly brings us all together. Part of the Badlands Film Appreciation Society's Foreign Views series \(bfas.art\).

events.description:
Join us for a fun, acapella filled evening with amazing drinks, charcuterie, and desserts along with fun auction items!

Harmony for Hope An Evening of Music, Celebration & Giving Join the Benefit Fund of McKenzie Health on Saturday, November 21, 2026, for Harmony for Hope, a special evening bringing our community together in support of McKenzie Health's Cancer Center!

This FREE, semi-formal event will feature an unforgettable a cappella performance by The Coats, along with delicious charcuterie, desserts, and an evening of fun. Alcoholic beverages will be available for purchase.

Break out your sparkles, stylish hats, and favorite semi-formal attire as we celebrate the power of community and generosity! Harmony for Hope will also kick off the Benefit Fund's Giving Tuesday campaign, featuring exciting silent and live auctions benefiting McKenzie Health's Cancer Center. Auction participation is completely optional, and all proceeds will help support exceptional cancer care close to home for patients and families throughout McKenzie County, western North Dakota, and eastern Montana.

And there's a little something extra! The first 100 guests to register will receive a special event gift as a thank-you for joining us! Admission is free, but registration is encouraged. Reserve your spot today and join us for an inspiring evening where music, generosity, and hope come together. Together, we can make a difference—one note, one gift, and one life at a time.

Known for his comedies or dramedies about oddballs, director Wes Anderson took his first foray into animation with the stop-motion film Fantastic Mr. Fox \(2009, PG\). Inspired by a story by British children's author Roald Dahl, the film features the titular character tryin g to support his family, only to fall back on his old thieving ways. When he goes after the farms of Boggis, Bunce, and Bean, his old ways t hreaten the entire animal community. They all then must pull together to stop the farmers bent on beating them out of their land. Part of the Badlands Film Appreciation Society's Family Fare series \(bfas.art\).

🦃🏃‍♀️ 3rd Annual Richland Ranger Turkey Trot! 🏃‍♂️🦃

It’s that time of year again… time to run before you eat! 😂

Join the Richland Rangers Hockey Team for our 3rd Annual Turkey Trot, where we combine two of America’s favorite Thanksgiving traditions: eating way too much and pretending running will make up for it. 🍗🥧

Whether you’re a serious runner, a casual walker, or someone whose only goal is to make it to the finish line without pulling a hamstring—we want YOU there!

And the best part? Your participation helps give back to our community! ❤️

So lace up those shoes, grab your family and friends, and come burn a few calories before you replace them with turkey, stuffing and pie!

Come run. Come walk. Come have fun. Come hungry. 😂

Because nothing says Thanksgiving like running for a good cause so you can feel slightly less guilty about that second piece of pie. 🥧🤣

Gobble Gobble! We’ll see you at the starting line!

Food Donations will also be accepted the day of the race!

Register by end of day November 14th to guarantee your race day t-shirt. Sign ups after November 14th do not guarantee a shirt.

This Turkey Trot is the perfect guilt-free solution for eating your weight in mashed potatoes.

5K - 9:00am

1 Mile Little Drumstick Run - 9:00am

The start and finish lines will be in the same location at Richland Youth Hockey arena

events.title: Auditions Clue
events.description:
AUDITION INFORMATION Monday, November 30, 2026 | 6:00–9:00 PM Location: 2nd Floor Dance Studio, May Hall Callbacks: Tuesday, December 1 | 6:00–9:00 PM Cast Announcement: Thursday, December 3 SIGN UP FOR YOUR AUDITION TIME! https://www.signupgenius.com/go/5080F44A5AA2AA6F49-67605085-clue Please plan to arrive about 15 minutes before your scheduled audition time.

WHAT DO I NEED TO PREPARE? Not much! If you have a comedic monologue you'd like to perform, wonderful! We would love to see it. Don't have a monologue? NO PROBLEM! We'll have selections from the Clue script available for you to read during auditions. We're looking for people who are willing to have fun, make bold choices, and bring some personality to the stage. You do NOT need previous theatre experience to audition!

MEET THE SUSPECTS! We have some fantastic characters to bring to life!Wadsworth: The uptight British butler desperately trying to keep everything under control.

Yvette: The loyal and alluring French maid.

Miss Scarlet: A sharp-tongued socialite who always seems to know more than she's saying.

Mrs. Peacock: A wealthy senator's wife who has a flair for the dramatic.

Mrs. White: A mysterious widow with a rather questionable marital history.

Colonel Mustard: A pompous military man who might not be quite as clever as he thinks.

Professor Plum: An arrogant academic who is definitely his own biggest fan.

Mr. Green: An anxious, nervous rule follower who seems to be hiding something.

AND THERE ARE MORE ROLES! We're also looking for performers to take on ensemble roles, including Mr. Boddy, the Cook, the Motorist, the Singing Telegram Girl, police officers, and more! These are great opportunities to have fun with different characters and get involved in the production.

IMPORTANT PRODUCTION DATES Rehearsals Begin: January 4, 2027 Performances: February 19–21, 2027 Regular rehearsals will take place Sunday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday evenings from 6:00–9:00 PM. We will also have a scheduled break January 17–21 for KCACTF.

COME JOIN US! One of my favorite things about the Blue Hawk Theatre Guild is that you don't have to be a theatre major to get involved. We have students from all different majors and backgrounds who come together to create something pretty incredible. If you've ever thought about trying theatre, THIS IS YOUR CHANCE! Come meet some new people, challenge yourself, earn some potential college credit, and help us put on a hilarious show. We would love to see some new faces alongside our returning Guild members!
